name: OpenFunnel Agent Primitives
description: Low-level building blocks for agents such as lookalike search, technography search, and deep research. Compose them into your own GTM workflows.

_published_faq.name: How do I add OpenFunnel Agent Primitives to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add OpenFunnel Agent Primitives to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://agents.openfunnel.dev/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the OpenFunnel Agent Primitives MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: OpenFunnel Agent Primitives provides these MCP tools: deep-research, get-credit-balance, get-user-info, list-country-codes, list-firmographic-options, lookup-companies, search-companies-by-tech-stack, and search-lookalikes.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to OpenFunnel Agent Primitives?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to OpenFunnel Agent Primitives in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does OpenFunnel Agent Primitives MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: OpenFunnel Agent Primitives requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
OpenFunnel Agent Primitives is developed by OpenFunnel. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
